parts.title: Into the Sand
parts.text: The expedition to map ancient dry riverbeds began before dawn. Amelia, a geologist, led her small team into a **forbidding** desert where nothing moved but the wind. The route was **arduous**: every step sank into loose sand, and the **scorching** sun climbed higher with each hour. Tobias, their cheerful guide, called himself a lifelong **wayfarer**, because he had walked desert roads since he was ten.

parts.title: Trouble at Noon
parts.text: By midday their water was nearly gone, and every throat felt **parched**. Sade, the youngest, pointed at a silver lake shimmering ahead. “It is only a **mirage**,” Tobias said gently. “The heat plays tricks on tired eyes.” Sade’s face looked **haggard** after a sleepless night, and as the heat pressed on she became **delirious**, mumbling about rivers and snow. Amelia wrapped a damp scarf around her neck and kept her walking.

parts.title: The Green Line
parts.text: Hope seemed to **wane** along with the daylight, but Amelia was **undeterred**. She unfolded her worn map and noticed a thin line of green on the horizon: palm trees. They pushed on, and at dusk they stumbled into a true **oasis**, where a spring bubbled in the shade. The long **ordeal** was over. For a while nobody spoke; they simply drank, then laughed.

parts.title: Marking the Map
parts.text: Later, by the light of a small fire, the team marked the dry riverbeds on their chart. Amelia wrote in her journal that the desert had not defeated them but had taught them to plan carefully, share every drop and trust one another. In the morning they would begin the journey home, tired and sunburned, but proud. Tobias promised to teach Sade how to read the stars on the way.

definitions.meaning1: Requiring great effort and endurance; very difficult and tiring. Example: The arduous climb took six hours.

definitions.meaning1: An optical illusion, such as a shimmering pool of water seen in a hot desert. Example: The lake on the road ahead was just a mirage caused by the heat.
definitions.meaning2: Something hoped for that turns out to be unreal. Example: The promise of quick riches proved to be a mirage.

definitions.meaning1: A fertile spot in a desert where there is water and plants. Example: The travelers rested in the shade of a green oasis.
definitions.meaning2: A peaceful place in the middle of a busy or stressful setting. Example: The quiet library was an oasis in the loud, crowded school.

definitions.meaning1: To gradually become smaller, weaker or less. Example: The moon begins to wane after it is full.
definitions.meaning2: A gradual decrease; used in the phrase on the wane. Example: As summer ended, the tourist crowds were on the wane.
